text: Block does not carry over. Both sides clear it at the start of their own turn.
A card with both Ethereal and Retain still burns at the end of your turn.
Artifact refuses one application, not one stack. Vulnerable 3 costs it all.
Vulnerable amplifies a hit before Intangible floors it, so the floor holds.
Poison ticks at the start of its holder's turn, and loses a stack as it ticks.
An Innate card is in your opening hand however deep the shuffle buried it.
A sleeping enemy re-telegraphs the moment it loses HP, while you hold the turn.
Retain does not shrink your next draw. A retained card makes it a six-card hand.
A Power leaves the fight when you play it. It is neither discarded nor exhausted.
An X-cost card at zero energy is refused rather than wasted.
Thorns bills an attacker even when your Block absorbed the whole hit.
Every Elite and Boss pays a relic, and a Boss pays from a pool of its own.
A ? room is never an Elite. It is a gamble, never an ambush.
Press {hd_pile_draw} to read your draw pile before you commit a card.
The belt holds three potions. A drop against a full belt is forfeited.
